facts.fact: The Gambia Information Commission's chairperson speaks of implementing the Access to Information Act, with six institutions having appointed information officers.
The Gambia Information Commission is in operation under its chairperson, who says draft regulations, validated, are with the Ministry of Justice.
The Information Commission's chairperson, Neneh MacDouall-Gaye, said in October 2025 that the Commission had received 15 complaints since its establishment.
